objective:
Follow these steps literally, one at a time, from the current page. Click only what each step names. Never type a URL, search, or take another route.
Where to find them, in the tutorial's own words: "Open any article and pick 'Book Creator' from the toolbox menu in the right sidebar."
1. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Book Creator'.
If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.

actions.intent: PRIMARY: toolbox menu in the right sidebar; role=button; text="Tools" | HINTS: container=Page tools navigation beside article
actions.instr: Clicking Tools in the right sidebar tools navigation
